name: Ga-sshuku Mono-gatari
source:
Swim club school training camp of summer 1995. Boys and girls occupy inn rooms, break into three groups and start everyday physical exercises and swimming practice. Who knows, maybe a new strong feeling is born out of small breaks and joint exercise.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
1995年夏天的游泳社合宿。男孩和女孩們住進旅館的房間，分成三組，開始每天的體能訓練和游泳練習。誰知道呢，也許一種新的強烈感情會在小小的休息和共同訓練中誕生。

［來自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-november-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]］
